title: Hermes X-Ray
summary: Observability lab for tool-using agents: model context, tool calls, verification gates, and persistence. Infrastructure for agent-assisted market research, not a trading bot with claimed PnL.
technicalDescription: A standalone HTML, CSS, and JavaScript observability lab exposes model-visible context, loop stages, tool events, token estimates, verification gates, and persistence boundaries for a Hermes-style agent.
